title: Do Coupons Create Sales, or Just Give Money Away?

s1.description: The question and the first impression: coupon recipients spend several times more

s2.description: Two traps: the retailer selects on shopping frequency, and selected households are at a high point

s3.description: Our approach and the main result: with comparable controls there is no detectable lift

s4.description: Mechanism: most coupons go unused, and the used ones buy what households already buy

s5.description: The limits of the data, the conclusion and recommendations for the retailer

s6.description: Appendix: robustness checks and method details
